implementationSummary: session.create now starts non-ephemeral Codex threads so resume has persisted rollout state.
session.resume now calls Codex thread/resume before reporting SDK resume success.
session.destroy / SDK disconnect now maps to thread/unsubscribe while preserving SDK session data for resume.
session.delete now maps to thread/archive and removes adapter session state.
thread/unsubscribe is guarded as idempotent for repeated SDK destroy/disconnect teardown.

SDK-visible resumed flow observed session.resume, user.message, assistant.message, and session.idle.
